   211→    text-shadow:0 2px 0 #0008, 0 0 18px #ffd24a44;}
   212→  .modal p{color:var(--muted);font-size:18px;margin:0 0 12px;}

   214→    border-radius:13px;margin:8px 0;font-size:19px;

   216→  .sellrow .price{margin-left:auto;color:var(--gold);font-size:17px;}
   217→  /* card feel: rows lift on hover, buttons pop — easy to read what's clickable */
   218→  .sellrow{transition:transform .14s ease, box-shadow .14s ease, border-color .14s ease;}
   219→  .sellrow:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#ffd24a66;box-shadow:0 8px 20px #0008, 0 0 0 1px #ffd24a22;}
   220→  .sellrow.legend{border-color:#ffd24a77;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#241c0c,#141020);}
   221→  .btn{transition:transform .1s ease, filter .1s ease, box-shadow .1s ease;letter-spacing:.3px;}
   222→  .btn:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(1.14);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #7a5a17,0 6px 14px #0006;}
   223→  .btn.blue:hover:not(:disabled){box-shadow:0 5px 0 #1c4a82,0 6px 14px #0006;}
   224→  .btn.gold{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe27a,#e0a51f);box-shadow:0 4px 0 #8a6410,0 6px 18px #ffd24a22;color:#1a1206;}
   225→  .shoptab{transition:filter .1s ease;} .shoptab:hover{filter:brightness(1.2);}
   226→  .btn{font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:8px;cursor:pointer;border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 9px;
   227→    background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-d));color:#1a1206;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #7a5a17;}
   228→  .btn:disabled{filter:grayscale(1) brightness(.6);cursor:not-allowed;box-shadow:none;}
   229→  .btn:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #7a5a17;}

   235→  .closebtn:hover{filter:brightness(1.15);transform:translateY(-1px);}

   545→// cobblestone walkways connecting the plaza to hubs, your town and the beach

   557→  const cx=22,cy=20; for(const h of hubs) seg(cx,cy,h.x,h.y); seg(cx,cy,34,32); seg(cx,cy,16,32); })();

   591→// =====================================================================
   592→//  UPTOWN — Kintara-style residential district (new east land, x46..62)
   593→//  Streets in a grid; homes get richer (Casa→Villa→Mansión) the deeper
   594→//  you go, so wealth reads visually. ₿ landmarks + SpaceZ pad + Moon Toucan.
   595→// =====================================================================
   596→const btcMarks=[{x:22,y:22}]; // ground ₿ emblems (plaza + uptown)
   597→const solMarks=[{x:24,y:20}]; // ground Solana logo emblems
   598→const uptownDecor=[];         // {x,y,kind} extra props (toucan statue, arch)
   599→const decor=[];               // map decorations (bushes, lamps, fountains, benches, rocks…)
   600→let clubPos=null;             // disco club tile (NPCs gather here to dance)
   601→(function buildUptown(){
   602→  const K=(x,y)=>x+','+y;
   603→  // --- avenues (horizontal) and streets (vertical) → cobblestone paths ---
   604→  const aves=[10,16,22,28,34], sts=[47,50,53,56,59];
   605→  for(const ay of aves) for(let x=46;x<=61;x++){ paths.add(K(x,ay)); }
   606→  for(const sx of sts) for(let y=9;y<=35;y++){ paths.add(K(sx,y)); }
   607→  // grand boulevard linking old plaza → uptown gate
   608→  for(let x=27;x<=46;x++) paths.add(K(x,22));
   609→  // --- homes line both sides of each avenue; tier rises east (wealth) ---
   610→  // tier picker: closer to the east edge / center = wealthier
   611→  const tierFor=(x,y)=>{ const east=(x-46)/15; const r=((x*73+y*131)%10)/10;
   612→    if(east>0.72) return r<0.55?3:2;          // far east → Mansion/Villa row
   613→    if(east>0.45) return r<0.5?2:(r<0.85?1:3);// mid → Villa/House (rare Mansion)
   614→    return r<0.55?1:(r<0.9?0:2); };           // entry → Casa/Cottage
   615→  const NAMES=['ditwhale','moonana','0xKira','degenz','satlord','lunafi','hodlr','vibez','toucan','pixel','kintaro','solgod','frostbyte','nova','zenith'];
   616→  let ni=0;
   617→  for(const ay of aves){
   618→    for(let x=47;x<=60;x+=3){
   619→      // skip the central plaza band so the toucan square stays open
   620→      if(ay===22 && x>=51 && x<=56) continue;
   621→      for(const side of [-3,3]){              // homes line BOTH sides of every avenue (fuller neighborhoods)
   622→        const ty=ay+side; if(ty<7||ty>37) continue;
   623→        if(houses.some(h=>h.x===x&&h.y===ty)) continue;   // avenues 6 apart share the row between them — no double-booking a plot
   624→        const tier=tierFor(x,ty);
   625→        const isEmpty=((x*31+ty*17)%3===0);   // ~1/3 buyable empty plots — always inventory for sale
   626→        houses.push({x, y:ty, owner:isEmpty?'empty':'npc', tier, label:isEmpty?'':(NAMES[ni++%NAMES.length]+'.sol')});
   627→      }
   628→    }
   629→  }
   630→  // --- landmarks ---
   631→  // Bitcoin ₿ plaza at the uptown gate + a second deep in the district
   632→  btcMarks.push({x:46,y:22},{x:57,y:22});
   633→  solMarks.push({x:50,y:22},{x:59,y:22});
   634→  // Moon Toucan plaza (open central square at 53,22)
   635→  uptownDecor.push({x:53,y:22,kind:'toucan'});   // 🦜 Moon Toucan statue (mascot)
   636→  uptownDecor.push({x:52,y:21,kind:'arch'});     // welcome arch
   637→})();

   639→// =====================================================================
   640→//  MARINA / DitBnB RESORT — new SE coast (the map extension, x/y 84..107)
   641→//  A bay + beach + boardwalk of high-tier villas tourists rent. Airbnb
   642→//  narrative: owners list homes, guests pay, condition wears faster.
   643→// =====================================================================
   644→(function buildMarina(){
   645→  const K=(x,y)=>x+','+y;
   646→  // --- the bay (big SE water) + sand shore ring ---
   647→  for(let y=84;y<MAP;y++)for(let x=84;x<MAP;x++){ if((x-98)**2+(y-98)**2<120) tiles[y][x]=1; }   // Marina Bay
   648→  for(let y=82;y<MAP;y++)for(let x=82;x<MAP;x++){ const d=(x-98)**2+(y-98)**2; if(tiles[y][x]===0 && d<170 && d>=120) tiles[y][x]=2; }  // beach ring
   649→  // --- Pacific Coast Hwy: road from Uptown down + along the shore ---
   650→  for(let y=35;y<=88;y++) paths.add(K(59,y));           // south from Uptown
   651→  for(let x=59;x<=92;x++) paths.add(K(x,88));           // east along the coast
   652→  for(let x=64;x<=90;x+=2) paths.add(K(x,86));          // boardwalk upper lane
   653→  // --- resort row: high-tier villas/mansions on the shore road, many for sale ---
   654→  const RN=['malibu','baywatch','oceanvw','surfside','palmdrm','sunsetkg','tidelord','wavehodl'];
   655→  let mi=0;
   656→  for(let x=63;x<=87;x+=3){
   657→    const ty=84;                                        // homes face the bay
   658→    if(tiles[ty] && tiles[ty][x]!==0) continue;         // skip water/sand
   659→    const r=((x*73+ty*131)%10)/10;
   660→    const tier=r<0.45?3:2;                              // resort = Mansion/Villa row
   661→    const isEmpty=((x*31+ty*17)%3===0);                 // 1/3 buyable
   662→    houses.push({x, y:ty, owner:isEmpty?'empty':'npc', tier, bnb:!isEmpty, label:isEmpty?'':(RN[mi++%RN.length]+'.sol')});
   663→  }
   664→  // --- second row inland (cheaper villas) ---
   665→  for(let x=64;x<=88;x+=4){
   666→    const ty=91; if(tiles[ty] && tiles[ty][x]!==0) continue;
   667→    const isEmpty=((x*13+ty*7)%2===0);                  // half buyable — inventory for new buyers
   668→    houses.push({x, y:ty, owner:isEmpty?'empty':'npc', tier:2, bnb:!isEmpty, label:isEmpty?'':(RN[mi++%RN.length]+'.sol')});
   669→  }
   670→  // (marina street signs are added in the billboards array below — it's declared after this IIFE)
   671→})();
   672→
   673→// =====================================================================
   674→//  DITCOIN HEIGHTS — a fresh residential development EAST of Uptown
   675→//  (x63..82, y10..38). A clean grid of streets lined with plots, most
   676→//  FOR SALE — this is the real-estate inventory: pick a lot & build.
   677→//  Cheap starter cottages on the west edge, mansions deep east.
   678→// =====================================================================
   679→(function buildHeights(){
   680→  const K=(x,y)=>x+','+y;
   681→  const taken=(x,y)=>houses.some(h=>h.x===x&&h.y===y)||(tiles[y]&&tiles[y][x]!==0);
   682→  // avenues (E–W) + streets (N–S) as cobblestone paths
   683→  const aves=[12,18,24,30,36], sts=[65,68,71,74,77,80];
   684→  for(const ay of aves) for(let x=63;x<=81;x++){ paths.add(K(x,ay)); }
   685→  for(const sx of sts) for(let y=10;y<=37;y++){ paths.add(K(sx,y)); }
   686→  // connector boulevard: Uptown (x61) -> Heights gate (x64) along the y22 avenue
   687→  for(let x=60;x<=64;x++) paths.add(K(x,22));
   688→  for(let y=22;y<=24;y++) paths.add(K(63,y));
   689→  // richer the deeper east you go, so wealth reads on the map
   690→  const tierFor=(x,y)=>{ const east=(x-63)/18, r=((x*57+y*113)%10)/10;
   691→    if(east>0.72) return r<0.5?3:2;            // mansion / villa row
   692→    if(east>0.42) return r<0.5?2:(r<0.85?1:3); // villa / house
   693→    return r<0.55?0:(r<0.9?1:2); };            // starter cottages / houses
   694→  const NM=['skyline','highroll','degenx','moonrise','solheir','vaultz','kryptr','ape0x','ditlord','stackz','gigawatt','neon','orbit','apex'];
   695→  let ni=0;
   696→  for(const ay of aves){
   697→    for(let x=64;x<=81;x+=3){
   698→      for(const side of [-2,2]){
   699→        const ty=ay+side; if(ty<9||ty>38) continue;
   700→        if(taken(x,ty)) continue;
   701→        const isEmpty=((x*17+ty*23)%9)>2;      // ~66% buyable — a city full of FOR SALE signs
   702→        houses.push({x, y:ty, owner:isEmpty?'empty':'npc', tier:tierFor(x,ty), label:isEmpty?'':(NM[ni++%NM.length]+'.sol')});
   703→      }
   704→    }
   705→  }
   706→  // entrance arch + Solana emblems on the ground (crypto flavor)
   707→  uptownDecor.push({x:63,y:22,kind:'arch'});
   708→  solMarks.push({x:71,y:24},{x:77,y:18});
   709→  btcMarks.push({x:74,y:30});
   710→  // (Heights street signs go in the billboards array literal below — TDZ if pushed here)
   711→})();
   712→
   713→// =====================================================================
   714→//  THE EXPANSION — the whole southern & eastern half of the doubled map.
   715→//  Six districts on a real street grid, wall-to-wall with plots FOR SALE.
   716→//  This is the land supply for 300+ players; almost nothing is pre-owned.
   717→// =====================================================================
   718→(function buildExpansion(){
   719→  const K=(x,y)=>x+','+y;
   720→  const taken=(x,y)=>!inB(x,y)||houses.some(h=>h.x===x&&h.y===y)||(tiles[y]&&tiles[y][x]!==0);
   721→  // district = {name, x0,y0,x1,y1, tier bias}
   722→  const DISTRICTS=[
   723→    {n:'SOUTH GARDENS', x0:16,  y0:116, x1:70,  y1:170, lo:0, hi:1},
   724→    {n:'NEW HORIZON',   x0:80,  y0:116, x1:140, y1:170, lo:1, hi:2},
   725→    {n:'EAST RIDGE',    x0:120, y0:20,  x1:180, y1:80,  lo:1, hi:3},
   726→    {n:'GOLDEN COAST',  x0:130, y0:120, x1:196, y1:186, lo:2, hi:3},
   727→    {n:'SUNSET PARK',   x0:16,  y0:180, x1:90,  y1:206, lo:0, hi:2},
   728→    {n:'THE HIGHLANDS', x0:150, y0:92,  x1:200, y1:112, lo:2, hi:3},
   729→  ];
   730→  const NM=['aurora','vertex','zenith','onyx','cobalt','ember','harbor','quartz','lumen','sable','ridge','delta','pyre','vesper','crest','halo','atlas','nova2','flint','orbit2'];
   731→  let ni=0;
   732→  for(const D of DISTRICTS){
   733→    // street grid: avenues every 6 rows, streets every 7 cols
   734→    for(let y=D.y0; y<=D.y1; y+=6) for(let x=D.x0; x<=D.x1; x++) if(inB(x,y)&&tiles[y][x]===0) paths.add(K(x,y));
   735→    for(let x=D.x0; x<=D.x1; x+=7) for(let y=D.y0; y<=D.y1; y++) if(inB(x,y)&&tiles[y][x]===0) paths.add(K(x,y));
   736→    // plots on both sides of every avenue
   737→    for(let ay=D.y0; ay<=D.y1; ay+=6){
   738→      for(let x=D.x0+2; x<=D.x1-1; x+=3){
   739→        for(const side of [-2,2]){
   740→          const ty=ay+side; if(!inB(x,ty)||taken(x,ty)) continue;
   741→          const r=((x*57+ty*113)>>>0)%10;
   742→          const tier=Math.min(D.hi, D.lo + (r<5?0:r<8?1:2));
   743→          // 90% for sale — the whole point: land supply for real players
   744→          const isEmpty=(((x*17+ty*23)>>>0)%10)>0;
   745→          houses.push({x, y:ty, owner:isEmpty?'empty':'npc', tier, label:isEmpty?'':(NM[ni++%NM.length]+'.sol')});
   746→        }
   747→      }
   748→    }
   749→    // a little parkland: scatter decor along the district's main avenue
   750→    const midY=D.y0+Math.floor((D.y1-D.y0)/2/6)*6;
   751→    for(let x=D.x0+3; x<=D.x1-3; x+=11){ if(inB(x,midY+1)&&tiles[midY+1][x]===0&&!taken(x,midY+1))
   752→      decor.push({x, y:midY+1, kind:(x%3===0?'bush':(x%3===1?'lamp':'flowers'))}); }
   753→  }
   754→  // ring roads connecting the old city to the new land
   755→  for(let y=36; y<=206; y++) if(inB(59,y)&&tiles[y][59]===0) paths.add(K(59,y));        // north-south spine
   756→  for(let x=16; x<=200; x++) if(inB(x,114)&&tiles[114][x]===0) paths.add(K(x,114));     // east-west belt
   757→  for(let y=20; y<=112; y++) if(inB(118,y)&&tiles[y][118]===0) paths.add(K(118,y));     // eastern avenue
   758→})();

   795→function inMyTerritory(x,y){ for(const t of towns) if(t.owner==='player' && Math.hypot(x-t.x,y-t.y)<=terrR(t)+0.5) return true;
   796→  for(const z of zones) if(z.owned && x>=z.x0&&x<=z.x1&&y>=z.y0&&y<=z.y1) return true; return false; }
   797→function nearestOwnedTown(x,y){ let best=null,bd=1e9; for(const t of towns) if(t.owner==='player'){const d=Math.hypot(x-t.x,y-t.y); if(d<bd){bd=d;best=t;}} return best; }

  1050→                [cx-12.5*Z,cy-31*Z,5*Z,15*Z,2.5*Z], // far arm
  1051→                [cx+7.5*Z,cy-31*Z,5*Z,15*Z,2.5*Z],  // near arm

  1164→function tileBlockedForPath(x,y){
  1165→  if(!inB(x,y))return true;
  1166→  if(bridges.has(x+','+y))return false;     // planks cross the water
  1167→  if(tiles[y][x]===1)return true;
  1168→  if(x===MARKET.x&&y===MARKET.y)return true;
  1169→  for(const t of towns) if(t.x===x&&t.y===y) return true;
  1170→  for(const h of houses){ const r=houseRadius(h); if(Math.abs(x-h.x)<=r&&Math.abs(y-h.y)<=r) return true; }
  1171→  for(const b of businesses){ if(Math.abs(x-b.x)<=1&&Math.abs(y-b.y)<=1) return true; }
  1172→  for(const d of decor){ if(d.kind==='club'){ if(Math.abs(x-d.x)<=1&&Math.abs(y-d.y)<=1) return true; } else if(d.x===x&&d.y===y&&d.kind!=='flowers'&&d.kind!=='parksign') return true; }
  1173→  for(const bb of billboards) if(bb.x===x&&bb.y===y) return true;
  1174→  for(const r of resources) if(!r.dead&&r.x===x&&r.y===y) return true;
  1175→  for(const s of structures) if(s.x===x&&s.y===y) return true;
  1176→  for(const p of plants) if(p.x===x&&p.y===y) return true;
  1177→  for(const h of hubs) if(h.x===x&&h.y===y) return true;
  1178→  return false;
  1179→}

  1203→function sfx(freq,dur=0.08,type='square',vol=0.04){ if(muted)return; try{ actx=actx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  1204→  const o=actx.createOscillator(),g=actx.createGain(); o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.value=vol;

  1207→function isoX(gx,gy){return (gx-gy)*(TW/2);}
  1208→function isoY(gx,gy){return (gx+gy)*(TH/2);}
  1209→let control=null;                 // active unit: the hero or a selected scout
  1210→function camera(){if(scene==='interior')return {x:VW/2-iav.px*zoom,y:VH/2-iav.py*zoom-10};if(scene==='frontier')return {x:VW/2-fav.px*zoom,y:VH/2-fav.py*zoom-10};const u=control||player;return {x:VW/2-u.px*zoom, y:VH/2-u.py*zoom-10};}
  1211→function screenToTile(mx,my){const c=camera();const wx=(mx-c.x)/zoom,wy=(my-c.y)/zoom;
  1212→  return {x:Math.round((wx/(TW/2)+wy/(TH/2))/2), y:Math.round((wy/(TH/2)-wx/(TW/2))/2)};}

  1214→function seedWorld(){
  1215→  resources.length=0;mobs.length=0;
  1216→  const occ=new Set(),k=(x,y)=>x+','+y; occ.add(k(MARKET.x,MARKET.y));
  1217→  for(const t of towns) occ.add(k(t.x,t.y));
  1218→  for(const h of houses){ const r=houseRadius(h); for(let dy=-r;dy<=r;dy++)for(let dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++) occ.add(k(h.x+dx,h.y+dy)); }
  1219→  for(const b of businesses){ for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++) occ.add(k(b.x+dx,b.y+dy)); }
  1220→  for(const bb of billboards) occ.add(k(bb.x,bb.y));
  1221→  const free=(pred)=>{for(let i=0;i<400;i++){const x=(Math.random()*MAP)|0,y=(Math.random()*MAP)|0;
  1222→    if(!inB(x,y)||tiles[y][x]!==0||occ.has(k(x,y)))continue; if(pred&&!pred(x,y))continue; occ.add(k(x,y));return{x,y};}return null;};
  1223→  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){const s=free();if(s)resources.push({type:'tree',x:s.x,y:s.y,hp:6,maxHp:6,dead:false,respawn:0});}   // scarce like kintara — competition over nodes
  1224→  for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const s=free();if(s)resources.push({type:'rock',x:s.x,y:s.y,hp:8,maxHp:8,dead:false,respawn:0});}
  1225→  // GOLD MINE — all nodes clustered in ONE spot, high HP & rare gold (longer grind with the pickaxe)
  1226→  { const c=free((x,y)=>Math.abs(x-SPAWN.x)+Math.abs(y-SPAWN.y)>10); if(c){ let placed=0;
  1227→    for(let dy=-1;dy<=1&&placed<8;dy++)for(let dx=-1;dx<=1&&placed<8;dx++){ const gx=c.x+dx,gy=c.y+dy;
  1228→      if(inB(gx,gy)&&tiles[gy][gx]===0&&!occ.has(k(gx,gy))){ occ.add(k(gx,gy)); resources.push({type:'gold',x:gx,y:gy,hp:45,maxHp:45,dead:false,respawn:90}); placed++; } } } }
  1229→  /* peaceful life mode — no hostile monsters spawn */ mobs.length=0;
  1230→}

  1233→/* ===================== WORKERS (auto-gatherers, AoE villager style) ===================== */
  1234→function homeTown(){return towns.find(t=>t.home)||towns.find(t=>t.owner==='player')||{x:SPAWN.x,y:SPAWN.y};}
  1235→function spawnWorker(){const h=homeTown();const s=adjWalk(h.x,h.y,h.x,h.y)||{x:SPAWN.x,y:SPAWN.y};
  1236→  workers.push({x:s.x,y:s.y,px:isoX(s.x,s.y),py:isoY(s.x,s.y),path:[],target:null,actCd:0});}
  1237→function nearestResource(x,y){let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const r of resources){if(r.dead)continue;
  1238→  const d=Math.abs(r.x-x)+Math.abs(r.y-y);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=r;}}return best;}
  1239→function updateWorkers(dt){
  1240→  for(const w of workers){
  1241→    w.actCd-=dt; stepAlong(w,dt,BASE_SPD*0.6);
  1242→    if(w.path&&w.path.length)continue;
  1243→    if(!w.target||w.target.dead){w.target=nearestResource(w.x,w.y);
  1244→      if(w.target){const s=adjWalk(w.target.x,w.target.y,w.x,w.y);if(s){const p=findPath(w.x,w.y,s.x,s.y);if(p)w.path=p;}}continue;}
  1245→    if(isAdj(w.x,w.y,w.target.x,w.target.y)){ if(w.actCd<=0){w.actCd=1.8;
  1246→      const r=w.target; r.hp--; player.collected++; if(r.type==='tree')player.inv.wood++;else player.inv.stone++;
  1247→      player.gold+=1; burst(isoX(r.x,r.y),isoY(r.x,r.y),r.type==='tree'?'#7ee07a':'#c9d2dc',4);
  1248→      refreshInv();refreshTop(); if(r.hp<=0){r.dead=true;r.respawn=8;w.target=null;} } }
  1249→    else { const s=adjWalk(w.target.x,w.target.y,w.x,w.y); if(s){const p=findPath(w.x,w.y,s.x,s.y);if(p)w.path=p; else w.target=null;} else w.target=null; }
  1250→  }
  1251→}
  1252→function hireWorker(){
  1253→  if(workers.length>=workerCap()){toast('Worker cap '+workerCap()+' — level up for more','bad');return;}
  1254→  const cost=30+workers.length*20;
  1255→  if(!wallet.admin&&player.gold<cost){toast('Need '+cost+' CP to hire','bad');return;}
  1256→  if(!wallet.admin)player.gold-=cost;
  1257→  spawnWorker(); refreshTop(); refreshEmpire(); if(warOpenTown)renderWar();
  1258→  toast('👷 Worker hired'+(wallet.admin?' (admin)':' (-'+cost+' CP)'),'good');
  1259→}

  1261→/* ===================== BODYGUARD (follows & defends the founder) ===================== */
  1262→function updateBodyguard(dt){
  1263→  bodyguard.cd-=dt; stepAlong(bodyguard,dt,BASE_SPD*1.25);
  1264→  if(!bodyguard.path.length){ const d=Math.abs(bodyguard.x-player.x)+Math.abs(bodyguard.y-player.y);
  1265→    if(d>2){ const s=adjWalk(player.x,player.y,bodyguard.x,bodyguard.y); if(s){const p=findPath(bodyguard.x,bodyguard.y,s.x,s.y); if(p)bodyguard.path=p;} } }
  1266→  for(const m of mobs){ if(m.dead)continue; if(Math.abs(m.x-bodyguard.x)+Math.abs(m.y-bodyguard.y)<=1 && bodyguard.cd<=0){
  1267→    bodyguard.cd=0.7; m.hp-=9; spawnFloatPx(m.x,m.y,'-9','#9fd0ff'); sfx(200,0.05,'square',0.03);
  1268→    if(m.hp<=0){m.dead=true;m.respawn=6;player.gold+=4;player.shards+=1;spawnFloatPx(m.x,m.y,'+4 CP','#ffe08a');refreshTop();} break; } }
  1269→}
  1270→function updateRoamers(dt){ for(const r of roamers){ r.t-=dt;
  1271→  if(r.dancing){ r.danceT-=dt; if(r.danceT<=0){ r.dancing=false; r.mode='wander'; r.t=0; } }
  1272→  const tx=isoX(r.tx,r.ty),ty=isoY(r.tx,r.ty),dx=tx-r.px,dy=ty-r.py,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),s=45*dt;
  1273→  if(d<=s){ r.px=tx; r.py=ty; r.x=r.tx; r.y=r.ty;
  1274→    if(!r.dancing && r.t<=0){ r.t=1.4+Math.random()*2.4;
  1275→      if(r.mode!=='club' && clubPos && Math.random()<0.14) r.mode='club';   // some head out clubbing
  1276→      if(r.mode==='club' && clubPos){
  1277→        const gx=clubPos.x+((r.name.length%3)-1), gy=clubPos.y+2;           // gather just south of the club
  1278→        if(Math.abs(r.x-gx)+Math.abs(r.y-gy)<=1){ r.dancing=true; r.danceT=6+Math.random()*8; }
  1279→        else { let best=null,bd=1e9; for(const [ox,oy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){ const nx=r.x+ox,ny=r.y+oy;
  1280→            if(inB(nx,ny)&&tiles[ny][nx]!==1&&!tileBlockedForPath(nx,ny)){ const dd=Math.abs(nx-gx)+Math.abs(ny-gy); if(dd<bd){bd=dd;best=[nx,ny];} } }
  1281→          if(best){ r.tx=best[0]; r.ty=best[1]; r.t=0.5+Math.random()*0.5; } else r.mode='wander'; }
  1282→      } else {
  1283→        // showcase residents travel the WHOLE map: pick a far destination and walk there over many steps
  1284→        if(r.showcase){
  1285→          if(!r.dest || (Math.abs(r.x-r.dest.x)+Math.abs(r.y-r.dest.y))<3){
  1286→            for(let k=0;k<30;k++){ const dx=(Math.random()*MAP)|0, dy=(Math.random()*MAP)|0;
  1287→              if(inB(dx,dy)&&tiles[dy][dx]===0&&!tileBlockedForPath(dx,dy)){ r.dest={x:dx,y:dy}; break; } }
  1288→          }
  1289→          if(r.dest){ // step one tile toward the destination, preferring roads
  1290→            const sx2=Math.sign(r.dest.x-r.x), sy2=Math.sign(r.dest.y-r.y);
  1291→            const cands=[[r.x+sx2,r.y],[r.x,r.y+sy2],[r.x+sx2,r.y+sy2]].filter(([a,b])=>inB(a,b)&&tiles[b][a]!==1&&!tileBlockedForPath(a,b));
  1292→            cands.sort((A,B)=>(paths.has(B[0]+','+B[1])?1:0)-(paths.has(A[0]+','+A[1])?1:0));
  1293→            if(cands.length){ r.tx=cands[0][0]; r.ty=cands[0][1]; r.t=0.25+Math.random()*0.2; }
  1294→            else r.dest=null;
  1295→          }
  1296→        } else { const nx=r.x+((Math.random()*7)|0)-3, ny=r.y+((Math.random()*7)|0)-3;
  1297→          if(inB(nx,ny)&&tiles[ny][nx]!==1&&!tileBlockedForPath(nx,ny)){ r.tx=nx; r.ty=ny; } } } } }
  1298→  else if(!r.dancing){ r.px+=dx/d*s; r.py+=dy/d*s;
  1299→    if(r.mount && Math.random()<dt*26){  // mounted NPCs kick the same kintara dirt as the player
  1300→      particles.push({px:r.px+(Math.random()-.5)*18, py:r.py+2+Math.random()*3,
  1301→        vx:(Math.random()-.5)*36, vy:-8-Math.random()*18, r:2+Math.random()*2.6,
  1302→        col:['#d8c8a4','#c9b48c','#a07048'][(Math.random()*3)|0], life:0.6+Math.random()*0.4}); } } } }
  1303→function updateLegendGuards(dt){
  1304→  legendGuards.forEach((g,i)=>{ g.cd-=dt; stepAlong(g,dt,BASE_SPD*1.3);
  1305→    if(!g.path.length){ const off=[[1,1],[-1,1],[1,-1]][i%3]; const tx=player.x+off[0],ty=player.y+off[1];
  1306→      const d=Math.abs(g.x-player.x)+Math.abs(g.y-player.y);
  1307→      if(d>2){ const s=adjWalk(player.x,player.y,g.x,g.y)||{x:tx,y:ty}; const p=findPath(g.x,g.y,s.x,s.y); if(p)g.path=p; } }
  1308→    for(const m of mobs){ if(m.dead)continue; if(Math.abs(m.x-g.x)+Math.abs(m.y-g.y)<=1 && g.cd<=0){
  1309→      g.cd=0.55; m.hp-=20; spawnFloatPx(m.x,m.y,'-20','#ffd24a'); sfx(220,0.05,'sawtooth',0.03);
  1310→      if(m.hp<=0){m.dead=true;m.respawn=6;player.gold+=6;player.shards+=2;spawnFloatPx(m.x,m.y,'+6 CP','#ffe08a');refreshTop();} break; } }
  1311→  });
  1312→}
  1313→function buyLegendGuard(){
  1314→  if(legendGuards.length>=3){ toast('Max 3 Legend Guards','bad'); return; }
  1315→  const spawn=()=>{ const g={x:player.x,y:player.y,px:player.px,py:player.py,path:[],cd:0}; legendGuards.push(g);
  1316→    flash=0.6; burst(player.px,player.py,'#ffd24a',40); sfx(620,0.14,'sawtooth',0.05);
  1317→    toast('🛡️ Legend Guard recruited! ('+legendGuards.length+'/3)','gold'); if(typeof checkQuests==='function')checkQuests(); };
  1318→  if(wallet.admin){ spawn(); return; }
  1319→  if(!wallet.connected){ toast('Connect Phantom to recruit','bad'); return; }
  1320→  // pay with $DITCOIN (the memecoin) if you have it, else SOL
  1321→  if(player.dit>=150){ player.dit-=150; refreshTop(); spawn(); toast('Paid 150 💎 $DITCOIN','gold'); }
  1322→  else payWithSol(0.25,'Legend Guard', ok=>{ if(ok)spawn(); });
  1323→}

  1325→/* ===================== BUSINESSES (passive income) ===================== */
  1326→const NPC_ROLE={broker:'The Sol Broker',tycoon:'The X Tycoon',agent:'The Agent'};

  1328→// ---- MINING RIGS: stackable machines. Cheap ones use CP; the powerful ones need SOL (real demand). ----
  1329→const RIGS=[
  1330→  {id:'mk1',  name:'Rig Mk I',   emoji:'🖥️', cur:'CP',  cost:400,  incomeMin:20},
  1331→  {id:'mk2',  name:'Rig Mk II',  emoji:'🖲️', cur:'CP',  cost:1200, incomeMin:55},
  1332→  {id:'mk3',  name:'Rig Mk III', emoji:'⚙️', cur:'SOL', cost:0.2,  incomeMin:140},
  1333→  {id:'mk4',  name:'ASIC Rig',   emoji:'🔧', cur:'SOL', cost:0.5,  incomeMin:320},
  1334→  {id:'farm', name:'GPU Farm',   emoji:'🏭', cur:'SOL', cost:1.0,  incomeMin:700},
  1335→];
  1336→function rigIncomeMin(){ let s=0; const r=player.rigs||{}; for(const m of RIGS) s+=(r[m.id]||0)*m.incomeMin; return s; }
  1337→function rigsOwned(){ const r=player.rigs||{}; return RIGS.reduce((n,m)=>n+(r[m.id]||0),0); }
  1338→function btcRigBusiness(){ return businesses.find(b=>b.name==='BTC Mining Rig'); }
  1339→function openRigs(){ const el=document.getElementById('rigs'); el.classList.add('open'); renderRigs(); }
  1340→function renderRigs(){ const m=document.getElementById('rigsModal'); player.rigs=player.rigs||{};
  1341→  m.innerHTML=`<h3>⛏️ MINING FARM</h3>
  1342→    <p>Stack rigs to grow your hashrate → more passive CP. Powerful rigs are bought with <b>◎ SOL</b>.</p>
  1343→    <div class="warrow">⚡ Hashrate income <b style="margin-left:6px">${rigIncomeMin()} CP/min</b> · rigs owned ${rigsOwned()}</div>
  1344→    ${RIGS.map(r=>{const have=player.rigs[r.id]||0; const can=r.cur==='CP'?(wallet.admin||player.gold>=r.cost):true;
  1345→      return `<div class="sellrow ${r.cur==='SOL'?'legend':''}"><span style="font-size:20px">${r.emoji}</span> ${r.name} <span class="cost" style="margin-left:6px">+${r.incomeMin}/min${have?' · x'+have:''}</span>
  1346→        <span class="ml" style="margin-left:auto"><button class="btn ${r.cur==='SOL'?'':'blue'}" data-rig="${r.id}" ${(!can)?'disabled':''}>${r.cur==='SOL'?('◎ '+r.cost):(r.cost+' CP')}</button></span></div>`;}).join('')}
  1347→    <button class="closebtn" id="rgx">CLOSE</button>
  1348→    <div class="controls">More rigs = more income, so there's always a next machine to buy. SOL rigs create real demand.</div>`;
  1349→  m.querySelector('#rgx').onclick=()=>document.getElementById('rigs').classList.remove('open');
  1350→  m.querySelectorAll('[data-rig]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>buyRig(b.dataset.rig));
  1351→}
  1352→function buyRig(id){ const r=RIGS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!r)return; player.rigs=player.rigs||{};
  1353→  if(r.cur==='CP'){ if(!wallet.admin&&player.gold<r.cost){toast('Need '+r.cost+' CP','bad');return;}
  1354→    if(!wallet.admin)player.gold-=r.cost; player.rigs[id]=(player.rigs[id]||0)+1;
  1355→    refreshTop();refreshEmpire(); sfx(520,0.1,'square',0.05); toast('⛏️ '+r.name+' online · +'+r.incomeMin+' CP/min','good'); renderRigs(); }
  1356→  else { payWithSol(r.cost, r.name, ok=>{ if(!ok)return; player.rigs[id]=(player.rigs[id]||0)+1;
  1357→    refreshTop();refreshEmpire(); flash=0.7; sfx(620,0.12,'triangle',0.05); toast('🔥 '+r.name+' online · +'+r.incomeMin+' CP/min','gold'); renderRigs(); }); }
  1358→}

  1360→let bizOpen=null;

  1363→  const owned=b.owner==='player';
  1364→  const desc = b.jet

  1366→            :'Buy the <b>private Jet</b> — the capstone of your empire. It unlocks travel to <b>The Frontier</b>, a new map with richer rewards.')
  1367→    : (owned?'You own this — it pays you while you play.':'Buy it once and earn <b>passive Crypto Points</b> forever, just for owning it.');
  1368→  m.innerHTML=`<h3>${b.emoji} ${b.name}</h3>
  1369→    <p style="font-size:11px">Run by <b>${NPC_ROLE[b.npc]}</b>. ${b.desc||''}</p>
  1370→    ${b.incomeMin>0?`<div class="warrow">💵 Income <b style="margin-left:6px">${b.incomeMin} CP/min</b>${owned?' · ✅ active':''}</div>`

  1372→    <div class="warrow">🔓 Requires <b style="margin-left:6px">Level ${b.lvl||1}</b>${player.level>=(b.lvl||1)?' · ✅':' · ❌ keep leveling'}</div>
  1373→    ${owned?`<div class="warrow">🏷️ Status <b style="margin-left:6px">OWNED</b></div>`

  1375→    ${owned&&b.name==='BTC Mining Rig'?`<div class="sellrow legend">⛏️ Mining farm <span class="cost" style="margin-left:6px">${rigsOwned()} rigs · +${rigIncomeMin()}/min</span><span class="ml" style="margin-left:auto"><button class="btn blue" id="mrig">Manage rigs</button></span></div>`:''}
  1376→    ${b.jet?'':`<div class="sellrow">💼 Work a shift <span class="cost" style="margin-left:6px">earn CP now (20s cooldown)</span><span class="ml" style="margin-left:auto"><button class="btn blue" id="work">Work</button></span></div>`}
  1377→    <button class="closebtn" id="bxc">CLOSE</button>
  1378→    <div class="controls">Buy with SOL for passive income, or just <b>work a shift</b> for quick CP. In production this accrues server-side.</div>`;
  1379→  m.querySelector('#bxc').onclick=()=>el.classList.remove('open');
  1380→  const bb=m.querySelector('#bb'); if(bb)bb.onclick=()=>buyBiz(b);
  1381→  const mr=m.querySelector('#mrig'); if(mr)mr.onclick=()=>{ el.classList.remove('open'); openRigs(); };

  1384→function workBiz(b){ const now=performance.now();
  1385→  if(!isWorkHours()){ const h=Math.floor(gameTime); toast('🏪 Closed — shifts pay 9:00–17:00 (it\'s '+String(h).padStart(2,'0')+':00). Build passive income instead!','bad'); return; }
  1386→  if(player.workCd&&now<player.workCd){ toast('💼 Resting — wait '+Math.ceil((player.workCd-now)/1000)+'s','bad'); return; }
  1387→  player.workCd=now+20000; const pay=25+player.level*5+((Math.random()*15)|0); player.gold+=pay; player.shiftsWorked=(player.shiftsWorked||0)+1; gainXp(2); refreshTop();
  1388→  if(typeof checkQuests==='function')checkQuests();
  1389→  burst(isoX(b.x,b.y),isoY(b.x,b.y),'#36d39a',16); sfx(500,0.1,'square',0.04);
  1390→  toast('💼 You worked at '+b.name+' — earned '+pay+' CP','good'); openBiz(b); }
  1391→function buyBiz(b){
  1392→  if(player.level<(b.lvl||1)){ toast('🔒 Reach Level '+b.lvl+' to buy '+b.name,'bad'); return; }
  1393→  const apply=()=>{ b.owner='player'; refreshTop(); refreshEmpire();
  1394→    flash=0.7; burst(isoX(b.x,b.y),isoY(b.x,b.y),'#36d39a',34); sfx(520,0.12,'triangle',0.05);
  1395→    if(b.jet){ player.hasJet=true; flash=1; shake=8; toast('✈️ You bought the Jet! The Frontier unlocks soon — endgame reached.','gold'); }
  1396→    else toast('🤝 Bought '+b.name+' — passive +'+b.incomeMin+' CP/min','gold');
  1397→    if(typeof checkQuests==='function')checkQuests(); openBiz(b); };
  1398→  if(wallet.admin){ apply(); return; }
  1399→  if(!wallet.connected){ toast('Connect Phantom to buy businesses (SOL)','bad'); return; }
  1400→  payWithSol(b.sol, b.name, ok=>{ if(ok)apply(); });
  1401→}

  1404→/* ===================== QUESTS (goal ladder / narrative chapters) ===================== */
  1405→let questAcc=0;
  1406→// ===== THE CAREER LADDER — ONE clear spine: buy property → collect rent → buy more → rank up =====
  1407→// Every quest names the exact next action, so a new player is never lost. Ranks mirror RANKS[].
  1408→const ownedH=()=>houses.filter(h=>h.owner==='player').length;          // all owned (home base included)
  1409→const boughtH=()=>houses.filter(h=>h.owner==='player'&&!h.home).length; // properties you actually BOUGHT
  1410→let QUESTS=[
  1411→ {id:'first', ch:'I',  t:'Buy your FIRST property',     d:'Find a 🪧 FOR SALE sign and tap it. You have 350 CP — enough for a Cottage.', dit:10, cp:100, done:false, cond:()=>boughtH()>=1, rank:'🎓 Student'},
  1412→ {id:'rent',  ch:'I',  t:'Collect your first rent',     d:'Your house pays you. Tap it and cash the rent in.',                            dit:10, cp:50,  done:false, cond:()=>(player.rentCollected||0)>=1},
  1413→ {id:'work',  ch:'I',  t:'Work a shift',                d:'Tap a 🏦 shop on the boulevard and hit Work (9:00–17:00).',                     dit:10, cp:50,  done:false, cond:()=>(player.shiftsWorked||0)>=1},
  1414→ {id:'second',ch:'II', t:'Buy your SECOND property',    d:'Two houses = double rent and a bigger airdrop. You become 💼 Professional.',    dit:20, cp:150, done:false, cond:()=>boughtH()>=2, rank:'💼 Professional'},
  1415→ {id:'look',  ch:'II', t:'Dress up: buy from the Shop', d:'Try it on the doll first. Everyone sees what you wear.',                         dit:15, cp:0,   done:false, cond:()=>(player.owned.outfits.length+player.owned.caps.length+player.owned.mounts.length)>3},
  1416→ {id:'four',  ch:'III',t:'Own 4 properties',            d:'A real portfolio. You rise to 📈 Investor.',                                    dit:30, cp:300, done:false, cond:()=>ownedH()>=4, rank:'📈 Investor'},
  1417→ {id:'biz',   ch:'III',t:'Buy your first business',     d:'A business pays CP/min the whole time you play.',                                dit:30, cp:200, done:false, cond:()=>businesses.some(b=>b.owner==='player')},
  1418→ {id:'villa', ch:'IV', t:'Upgrade a house to a Villa',  d:'Improve a property — unlocks a pool 🏊 and more rent.',                          dit:25, cp:0,   done:false, cond:()=>houses.some(h=>h.owner==='player'&&h.tier>=2)},
  1419→ {id:'six',   ch:'IV', t:'Own 6 properties',            d:'You are now 🏢 Entrepreneur: heavy rent, big airdrop.',                          dit:40, cp:500, done:false, cond:()=>ownedH()>=6, rank:'🏢 Entrepreneur'},
  1420→ {id:'drop',  ch:'IV', t:'Claim an airdrop',            d:'Open 🎁 AIRDROP. The more property you hold, the more you get.',                 dit:25, cp:0,   done:false, cond:()=>(player.dropsClaimed||0)>=1},
  1421→ {id:'mansion',ch:'V', t:'Own a Mansion',               d:'The crown of the neighborhood.',                                                 dit:50, cp:0,   done:false, cond:()=>houses.some(h=>h.owner==='player'&&h.tier>=3)},
  1422→ {id:'rich',  ch:'V',  t:'Reach 100 CP/min in rent',    d:'Income while you sleep. You are 🚀 Mogul.',                                    dit:60, cp:0,   done:false, cond:()=>{let i=0;for(const h of houses)if(h.owner==='player')i+=(4+h.tier*4);for(const b of businesses)if(b.owner==='player')i+=b.incomeMin;return i>=100;}, rank:'🚀 Mogul'},
  1423→ {id:'ten',   ch:'VI', t:'Own 10 properties',           d:'A complete real-estate empire. 🪐 Visionary.',                                   dit:100,cp:1000,done:false, cond:()=>ownedH()>=10, rank:'🪐 Visionary'},
  1424→];
  1425→function currentQuest(){return QUESTS.find(q=>!q.done);}
  1426→function checkQuests(){let changed=false;
  1427→  for(const q of QUESTS){ if(!q.done && q.cond && q.cond()){ q.done=true; changed=true;
  1428→    if(q.cp)player.gold+=q.cp; if(q.dit)player.dit+=q.dit; refreshTop();
  1429→    flash=Math.max(flash,0.6); sfx(760,0.16,'triangle',0.05);
  1430→    toast('✅ '+q.t+(q.dit?'  +'+q.dit+' 💎':'')+(q.cp?'  +'+q.cp+' CP':''),'good');
  1431→    if(q.rank){ // CAREER PROMOTION — the big dopamine beat
  1432→      flash=1; shake=Math.max(shake,7); burst(player.px,player.py,'#ffd24a',60); sfx(880,0.28,'triangle',0.07);
  1433→      spawnFloatPx(player.x,player.y,'PROMOTED!','#ffd24a');
  1434→      setTimeout(()=>toast('🎉 PROMOTED — you are now '+q.rank+'. More property = bigger airdrop 🎁','gold'),700);
  1435→      if(typeof serverAnnounce==='function') serverAnnounce((player.name||'A player')+' was promoted to '+q.rank+'!');
  1436→      if(typeof offerShare==='function') offerShare('rank_'+q.id, 'I was just promoted to '+q.rank+' in Ditcoin City. 🏙️'); }
  1437→    else if(typeof offerShare==='function') offerShare('quest_'+q.id, 'Achievement unlocked in Ditcoin City: '+q.t+' ✅'); } }
  1438→  if(changed){ updateObjective(); if(document.getElementById('quest').classList.contains('open'))renderQuests(); }
  1439→}
  1440→function updateObjective(){ const cq=currentQuest(); const el=document.getElementById('objective');
  1441→  if(el) el.textContent = cq?('🎯 NOW: '+cq.t):'🏆 Empire complete — you are 🪐 Visionary'; }
  1442→function openQuests(){ tutState.qOpened=true; document.getElementById('quest').classList.add('open'); renderQuests(); }

  1516→  if(!wallet.admin&&(player.inv.wood<cost.wood||player.inv.stone<cost.stone||player.gold<cost.cp)){toast('Not enough materials for the wall','bad');return;}

  1522→function terrR(t){return TERR_R+(t.wall||0);} // villages expand as you raise the wall level
  1523→function zoneOwner(x,y){let best=null,bd=1e9;
  1524→  for(const t of towns){const r=terrR(t),d=Math.hypot(t.x-x,t.y-y);if(d<=r&&d<bd){bd=d;best=t;}}return best;}

  1528→  for(const h of houses){const r=houseRadius(h);for(let dy=-r;dy<=r;dy++)for(let dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++)occ.add(k(h.x+dx,h.y+dy));}

  1531→  const free=(x,y)=>inB(x,y)&&tiles[y][x]===0&&!paths.has(k(x,y))&&!occ.has(k(x,y));
  1532→  const put=(x,y,kind)=>{ if(free(x,y)){decor.push({x,y,kind});occ.add(k(x,y));return true;} return false; };
  1533→  const aves=[10,16,22,28,34];
  1534→  for(const ay of aves){ for(let x=46;x<=61;x+=4){ put(x,ay+1,'lamp'); put(x+2,ay-1,'bush'); } }
  1535→  put(50,25,'fountain'); put(51,24,'bench'); put(49,26,'bench'); put(55,25,'flowers'); put(56,20,'lamp');
  1536→  for(let y=4;y<MAP-2;y+=3)for(let x=4;x<MAP-2;x+=3){ const h=((x*92821+y*68917)>>>0);
  1537→    if(h%3===0) put(x,y, ['bush','flowers','rock','bush','flowers','bush'][h%6]); }

  1539→  { const hb=towns.find(t=>t.owner==='player')||towns[0];
  1540→    if(hb){ const ring=[[2,0,'lamp'],[-2,0,'lamp'],[0,2,'fountain'],[2,2,'flowers'],[-2,2,'bench'],[2,-2,'bench'],[-2,-2,'flowers'],[3,1,'bush'],[-3,1,'bush'],[1,3,'flowers'],[-1,3,'flowers'],[3,-1,'crate'],[-3,-1,'barrel'],[0,-3,'parksign']];
  1541→      for(const [dx,dy,k] of ring){ put(hb.x+dx,hb.y+dy,k); } } }

  1550→      put(px+2,py,'lamp');put(px-2,py,'lamp');put(px,py+2,'fountain');put(px+2,py+2,'bush');put(px-2,py-2,'bush'); break; } }
  1551→}

  1554→// ---- pathfinding ----
  1555→function findPath(sx,sy,tx,ty){
  1556→  if(!inB(tx,ty)||tileBlockedForPath(tx,ty))return null;
  1557→  const open=[{x:sx,y:sy,g:0,f:0,p:null}],seen=new Map(),k=(x,y)=>x+','+y;seen.set(k(sx,sy),0);
  1558→  const D=[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]];let guard=0;
  1559→  while(open.length&&guard++<6000){open.sort((a,b)=>a.f-b.f);const c=open.shift();
  1560→    if(c.x===tx&&c.y===ty){const p=[];let n=c;while(n.p){p.push({x:n.x,y:n.y});n=n.p;}return p.reverse();}
  1561→    for(const[dx,dy]of D){const nx=c.x+dx,ny=c.y+dy;if(!inB(nx,ny)||tileBlockedForPath(nx,ny))continue;
  1562→      const ng=c.g+1;if(seen.has(k(nx,ny))&&seen.get(k(nx,ny))<=ng)continue;seen.set(k(nx,ny),ng);
  1563→      open.push({x:nx,y:ny,g:ng,f:ng+Math.abs(nx-tx)+Math.abs(ny-ty),p:c});}}
  1564→  return null;
  1565→}
  1566→function adjWalk(gx,gy,fx,fy){const c=[[gx+1,gy],[gx-1,gy],[gx,gy+1],[gx,gy-1]]
  1567→  .filter(([x,y])=>inB(x,y)&&!tileBlockedForPath(x,y));
  1568→  c.sort((a,b)=>(Math.abs(a[0]-fx)+Math.abs(a[1]-fy))-(Math.abs(b[0]-fx)+Math.abs(b[1]-fy)));
  1569→  return c[0]?{x:c[0][0],y:c[0][1]}:null;}
  1570→const isAdj=(ax,ay,bx,by)=>Math.abs(ax-bx)+Math.abs(ay-by)===1;
  1571→

  1573→let hover={x:-1,y:-1};
  1574→cv.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();hover=screenToTile(e.clientX-r.left,e.clientY-r.top);});
  1575→let _lastTouch=0;   // a tap fires touchstart AND a synthetic click ~300ms later — only act once
  1576→cv.addEventListener('click',e=>{ if(performance.now()-_lastTouch<600)return;
  1577→  const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();const t=screenToTile(e.clientX-r.left,e.clientY-r.top);handleClick(t.x,t.y);});

  1579→cv.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{ _lastTouch=performance.now();
  1580→  syncCanvasSize();                                  // make sure VW/VH match before converting the tap
  1581→  const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();const tch=e.touches[0];

  1583→  hover=t; handleClick(t.x,t.y);},{passive:true});

  1585→function handleClick(gx,gy){
  1586→  if(!started)return;
  1587→  if(scene==='interior'){clickInterior(gx,gy);return;}
  1588→  if(scene==='frontier'){clickFrontier(gx,gy);return;}
  1589→  if(!inB(gx,gy))return;
  1590→  // click a PERSON -> open their profile card (see their look/props so you want to buy it)
  1591→  const rm=roamers.find(r=>(r.x===gx&&r.y===gy)||(r.tx===gx&&r.ty===gy));
  1592→  if(rm){ openPersonProfile(rm); return; }
  1593→  for(const r of remotePlayers.values()){ if(r.x===gx&&r.y===gy){ const L=r.look||{};
  1594→    openPersonProfile({name:r.name||'Player', mount:L.m||'none', aura:'none', cap:L.c||'', weapon:(typeof WEAPONS!=='undefined'&&WEAPONS[L.w]?WEAPONS[L.w].emoji:'⚔️'), vip:!!L.vip}); return; } }
  1595→  if(buildSel){ placeStructure(gx,gy); return; }
  1596→  const fz=signZone(gx,gy); if(fz){ buyZone(fz); return; }
  1597→  for(const p of plants){ if(p.x===gx&&p.y===gy){ harvestPlant(p); return; } }
  1598→  const gc=giftChestAt(gx,gy); if(gc){ player.target={kind:'go',fx:gx,fy:gy,cb:()=>claimGiftChest(gc)}; routeAdj(gx,gy); return; }
  1599→  const hb=hubAt(gx,gy); if(hb){ openHub(hb); return; }
  1600→  if(tiles[gy][gx]===1 && !bridges.has(gx+','+gy)){ tryFish(gx,gy); return; }
  1601→  if(control&&control!==player){ // moving a scout: just travel + reveal fog
  1602→    const sc=control, dest=tileBlockedForPath(gx,gy)?adjWalk(gx,gy,sc.x,sc.y):{x:gx,y:gy};
  1603→    if(dest){const p=findPath(sc.x,sc.y,dest.x,dest.y); if(p)sc.path=p;} return; }
  1604→  if(gx===MARKET.x&&gy===MARKET.y){player.target={kind:'go',fx:gx,fy:gy,cb:openMarket};routeAdj(gx,gy);return;}
  1605→  const tw=towns.find(t=>t.x===gx&&t.y===gy);
  1606→  if(tw){
  1607→    if(tw.owner==='enemy'){ player.target={kind:'keep',ref:tw}; routeAdj(gx,gy); }
  1608→    else { player.target={kind:'go',fx:gx,fy:gy,cb:()=>onTownReach(tw)}; routeAdj(gx,gy); }
  1609→    return; }
  1610→  const hs=houses.find(h=>h.x===gx&&h.y===gy);
  1611→  if(hs){ player.target={kind:'go',fx:gx,fy:gy,cb:()=>{ if(hs.owner==='empty')openHouse(hs); else enterInterior(hs); }}; routeAdj(gx,gy); return; }
  1612→  const bz=businesses.find(b=>b.x===gx&&b.y===gy);
  1613→  if(bz){ player.target={kind:'go',fx:gx,fy:gy,cb:()=>openBiz(bz)}; routeAdj(gx,gy); return; }
  1614→  const res=resources.find(r=>!r.dead&&r.x===gx&&r.y===gy);
  1615→  if(res){player.target={kind:'res',ref:res};routeAdj(gx,gy);return;}
  1616→  const mob=mobs.find(m=>!m.dead&&m.x===gx&&m.y===gy);
  1617→  if(mob){player.target={kind:'mob',ref:mob};routeAdj(mob.x,mob.y);return;}
  1618→  if(tiles[gy][gx]===1){player.target={kind:'fish',fx:gx,fy:gy};routeAdj(gx,gy);return;}
  1619→  player.target=null;const p=findPath(player.x,player.y,gx,gy);if(p)player.path=p;
  1620→}
  1621→function routeAdj(gx,gy){if(isAdj(player.x,player.y,gx,gy)){player.path=[];return;}
  1622→  const s=adjWalk(gx,gy,player.x,player.y);if(s){const p=findPath(player.x,player.y,s.x,s.y);if(p)player.path=p;}}
  1623→function onTownReach(t){ if(t.owner==='player') openWar(t);
  1624→  else if(t.owner==='neutral') claimTown(t); }

  1626→// ---- update ----
  1627→let last=performance.now();
  1628→let gameTime=8, lastClockMin=-1;           // in-game hours (full day ~6 real minutes)
  1629→function isWorkHours(){ return gameTime>=9 && gameTime<17; }
  1630→function advanceClock(dt){ gameTime += dt*(24/360); if(gameTime>=24)gameTime-=24;
  1631→  const mm=Math.floor(gameTime*60); if(mm===lastClockMin)return; lastClockMin=mm;
  1632→  const h=Math.floor(gameTime), m=Math.floor((gameTime-h)*60);
  1633→  const open=isWorkHours();
  1634→  const el=document.getElementById('clock'); if(el){ const icon=gameTime>=6&&gameTime<19?'🕘':'🌙';
  1635→    el.firstChild.nodeValue=icon+' '+String(h).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+' ';
  1636→    const tag=document.getElementById('clockTag'); tag.textContent=open?'OPEN 9–5':'CLOSED'; tag.style.color=open?'#36d39a':'#ff8a8a'; } }
  1637→function update(dt){
  1638→  if(scene==='interior'){updateInterior(dt);return;}
  1639→  if(scene==='frontier'){updateFrontier(dt);return;}
  1640→  if(!window._bizSwept){ window._bizSwept=true;   // one-time: no tree/rock may block a storefront door
  1641→    for(const b of businesses) for(const r of resources){ if(!r.dead && Math.abs(r.x-b.x)<=2 && Math.abs(r.y-b.y)<=2){ r.dead=true; r.respawn=9e9; } } }
  1642→  advanceClock(dt);
  1643→  const z=zoneOwner(player.x,player.y), hostile=z&&z.owner!=='player';
  1644→  let pspd=BASE_SPD*((BOOTS[player.boots]||BOOTS.none).mult)*((MOUNTS[player.mount]||MOUNTS.none).spd); if(hostile)pspd*=0.5;
  1645→  player.moving=stepAlong(player,dt,pspd);
  1646→  // movement dust — mounts kick a THICK dirt cloud behind them, walking a light scuff (kintara flex)
  1647→  if(player.moving && !player.spectator){ const _mtd=(player.mount&&player.mount!=='none');
  1648→    const _n=_mtd?4:1;                                                  // mounts spawn a thick burst of puffs each frame
  1649→    for(let _k=0;_k<_n;_k++){ if(Math.random()<dt*(_mtd?75:9)){
  1650→      const _dust=['#d8c8a4','#c9b48c','#a07048','#9a6840'][(Math.random()*4)|0];   // sand + earth browns (kintara fur palette)
  1651→      particles.push({px:player.px+(Math.random()-.5)*(_mtd?28:9), py:player.py+2+Math.random()*4,
  1652→        vx:(Math.random()-.5)*(_mtd?52:30), vy:-10-Math.random()*(_mtd?26:10), r:(_mtd?3.2:1.2)+Math.random()*(_mtd?3.8:1.4),
  1653→        col:_dust, life:(_mtd?0.85:0.4)+Math.random()*0.5}); } } }
  1654→  // equipped TRAIL — glowing footsteps that linger behind you (kintara flex)
  1655→  if(player.moving && !player.spectator){ const _TR=TRAILS[player.trail||'none'];
  1656→    const _tc=_TR&&(_TR.rgb?rgbHue(0):_TR.color);
  1657→    if(_tc && Math.random()<dt*20){ particles.push({px:player.px+(Math.random()-.5)*8, py:player.py+1,
  1658→      vx:(Math.random()-.5)*8, vy:-26-Math.random()*10, r:1.5+Math.random()*1.3, col:_tc, life:0.75+Math.random()*0.35}); } }
  1659→  if(hostile){player.terrCd=(player.terrCd||0)-dt; if(player.terrCd<=0){player.terrCd=1.6;damagePlayer(2);}}
  1660→  for(const sc of scouts) stepAlong(sc,dt,BASE_SPD*1.6);
  1661→  updateWorkers(dt);
  1662→  updateBodyguard(dt);
  1663→  updateLegendGuards(dt);
  1664→  updateRoamers(dt);
  1665→  if(typeof updateCritters==='function')updateCritters(dt);
  1666→  mpTick(); updateRemotes(dt);
  1667→  if(player.rallyCd>0){const was=player.rallyCd;player.rallyCd-=dt;if(player.rallyCd<=0){player.rallyCd=0;renderControl();}}
  1668→  computeFog();
  1669→
  1670→  player.actCd-=dt;player.hurtCd-=dt;
  1671→  if(player.target&&!player.moving){const t=player.target;
  1672→    if(t.kind==='go'){if(isAdj(player.x,player.y,t.fx,t.fy)){t.cb&&t.cb();player.target=null;}else if(!player.path.length)routeAdj(t.fx,t.fy);}
  1673→    else if(t.kind==='res'&&!t.ref.dead&&isAdj(player.x,player.y,t.ref.x,t.ref.y)){if(player.actCd<=0){player.actCd=0.55;gather(t.ref);}}
  1674→    else if(t.kind==='fish'&&isAdj(player.x,player.y,t.fx,t.fy)){if(player.actCd<=0){player.actCd=0.8;doFish();}}

  1715→  return true; }

  1722→/* ===================== WAR SYSTEM ===================== */
  1723→let waveTimer=28, waveNum=0, graceLeft=80, graceAnnounced=false, barracksAcc=0;
  1724→let stakePool=3000;   // in-game PROPERTY STAKING POOL — funded by purchase taxes, pays daily dividends to holders
  1725→let bannerMsgs=[];    // recent expensive purchases shown flying across on the banner plane
  1726→function ownedTowns(){return towns.filter(t=>t.owner==='player');}
  1727→function updateWar(dt){
  1728→  // passive income + training
  1729→  let perSec=0;
  1730→  for(const t of ownedTowns()){
  1731→    perSec += INCOME_BASE + (t.barracks?INCOME_BARRACKS:0);
  1732→    if(t.q>0){ t.qt-=dt; if(t.qt<=0){ t.soldiers++; t.q--; t.qt = t.q>0?SOLDIER_TIME:0; spawnFloatPx(t.x,t.y,'+1 ⚔','#9fe3ff'); refreshEmpire(); if(warOpenTown===t) renderWar(); } }
  1733→  }
  1734→  for(const b of businesses) if(b.owner==='player') perSec += b.incomeMin/60; // businesses = passive income
  1735→  perSec += rigIncomeMin()/60; // mining rigs hashrate
  1736→  // RENT BANK (Clash-style): each property fills a rent jar you must TAP to collect — the reason to come back.
  1737→  for(const h of houses) if(h.owner==='player'){
  1738→    const cap=rentCap(h); h.rentBank=Math.min(cap,(h.rentBank||0)+rentPerMin(h)/60*dt); }
  1739→  // PROPERTY STAKING DIVIDENDS — paid from the shared pool, proportional to what you have staked
  1740→  stakePool += dt*3;   // realm-wide purchase taxes trickle into the pool (simulated economy)
  1741→  let _div=0; for(const h of houses) if(h.owner==='player'){ if(h.condition==null)h.condition=100;
  1742→    h.condition=Math.max(0,h.condition-dt*(h.bnb?0.15:0.05));                       // DitBnB guests wear the house 3× faster
  1743→    _div += houseStaked(h)*0.0010*(h.condition/100)*(h.bnb?1.75:1); }               // listed on DitBnB = +75% yield (tourists pay rent)
  1744→  if(stakePool>0 && _div>0){ _div=Math.min(_div, stakePool/Math.max(dt,0.001)); stakePool=Math.max(0,stakePool-_div*dt); perSec+=_div; }
  1745→  player.incAcc += perSec*dt;
  1746→  if(player.incAcc>=1){ const add=Math.floor(player.incAcc); player.gold+=add; player.incAcc-=add; refreshTop(); }
  1747→  // placed barracks train soldiers for the nearest town
  1748→  // (barracks/soldier training removed — no armies in a real-estate city)
  1749→
  1750→  // ===== NO COMBAT. Ditcoin City is a peaceful real-estate world — no raids, no waves, ever. =====
  1751→  armies.length=0;
  1752→  // armies march & siege
  1753→  let incoming=null;
  1754→  for(let i=armies.length-1;i>=0;i--){const a=armies[i];const t=a.town;
  1755→    const tx=isoX(t.x,t.y),ty=isoY(t.x,t.y);const dx=tx-a.px,dy=ty-a.py,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  1756→    if(t.owner!=='player'){armies.splice(i,1);continue;} // town fell elsewhere
  1757→    // defenders open fire THE MOMENT raiders approach — towers + garrison soldiers + placed Guard Towers
  1758→    const placedTw=structures.filter(s=>s.type==='tower'&&Math.hypot(s.x-t.x,s.y-t.y)<=terrR(t)+1).length;
  1759→    const towerN=(t.towers||0)+placedTw;
  1760→    if(towerN>0||t.soldiers>0||legendGuards.length>0){ a.fireCd=(a.fireCd||0)-dt;
  1761→      if(a.fireCd<=0){ a.fireCd=0.5;
  1762→        const tdmg=towerN*3*(t.elite?3:1);              // towers hit harder now
  1763→        const sdmg=Math.ceil((t.soldiers||0)*0.3);       // guards skirmish from the walls
  1764→        const playerNear=Math.hypot(player.x-t.x,player.y-t.y)<=terrR(t)+3;   // you + your guards rush in
  1765→        const gdmg=playerNear?(legendGuards.length*4 + 3):0;                  // bodyguard + legend guards
  1766→        const dmg=tdmg+sdmg+gdmg;
  1767→        if(dmg>0){ a.count-=dmg; burst(a.px,a.py,'#9fe3ff',8); floatPx(a.px,a.py,'-'+dmg,'#bfe9ff'); shake=Math.max(shake,2);
  1768→          if(a.count<=0){ floatPx(a.px,a.py,'WIPED','#36d39a'); armies.splice(i,1); continue; } } } }
  1769→    if(d>34){ a.px+=dx/d*40*dt; a.py+=dy/d*40*dt; incoming=t.name; }
  1770→    else { incoming=t.name; a.battle-=dt;
  1771→      if(a.battle<=0){ a.battle=0.6; resolveSiege(a,t,i); }
  1772→    }
  1773→  }
  1774→  const warnEl=document.getElementById('warn');
  1775→  if(incoming){warnEl.classList.add('show');document.getElementById('warnTown').textContent=incoming;}
  1776→  else warnEl.classList.remove('show');
  1777→  questAcc=(questAcc||0)+dt; if(questAcc>=1){questAcc=0; checkQuests();}
  1778→  checkTutorial(dt);
  1779→}

  1806→  } else if(t.hp<=0){ // pueblo perdido

  1808→    toast('💀 You lost '+t.name,'bad'); armies.splice(idx,1);
  1809→    refreshEmpire(); if(warOpenTown===t) closeWar();
  1810→  }
  1811→  refreshEmpire(); if(warOpenTown===t&&document.getElementById('war').classList.contains('open')) renderWar();

  1882→// ===== RENT: the core loop. Properties fill a rent jar; you TAP to collect (dopamine + reason to return) =====
  1883→function rentPerMin(h){ return Math.round((6+h.tier*7)*(houseCondition(h)/100)*(h.bnb?1.75:1)*(passActive()?1.10:1)); }
  1884→function rentCap(h){ return rentPerMin(h)*(passActive()?360:120); }   // 2 h jar, 6 h with the Empire Pass
  1885→function totalRentReady(){ let s=0; for(const h of houses) if(h.owner==='player') s+=Math.floor(h.rentBank||0); return s; }
  1886→function collectRent(h){ const amt=Math.floor(h.rentBank||0);
  1887→  if(amt<1){ toast('No rent has piled up here yet','bad'); return; }
  1888→  h.rentBank=0; player.gold+=amt; player.rentCollected=(player.rentCollected||0)+1;
  1889→  spawnFloatPx(h.x,h.y,'+'+amt+' 🪙','#ffd24a'); burst(isoX(h.x,h.y),isoY(h.x,h.y),'#ffd24a',22); sfx(680,0.12,'triangle',0.05);
  1890→  refreshTop(); if(typeof checkQuests==='function')checkQuests(); if(houseOpen===h)renderHouse(); }
  1891→function collectAllRent(){ let total=0,n=0;
  1892→  for(const h of houses) if(h.owner==='player'){ const a=Math.floor(h.rentBank||0); if(a>0){ total+=a; n++; h.rentBank=0; spawnFloatPx(h.x,h.y,'+'+a,'#ffd24a'); } }
  1893→  if(!total){ toast('No rent ready yet — come back in a few minutes','bad'); return; }
  1894→  player.gold+=total; player.rentCollected=(player.rentCollected||0)+1; flash=Math.max(flash,0.5); sfx(760,0.16,'triangle',0.06);
  1895→  toast('💰 Collected '+total.toLocaleString()+' CP from '+n+' propert'+(n>1?'ies':'y'),'gold');
  1896→  refreshTop(); if(typeof checkQuests==='function')checkQuests(); }
  1897→// offline earnings: your properties keep paying while you're away (capped) — the "come back tomorrow" hook
  1898→function applyOfflineRent(){ const now=Date.now(), last=player.lastSeen||now; player.lastSeen=now;
  1899→  const mins=Math.min(120,(now-last)/60000); if(mins<1)return 0; let total=0;
  1900→  for(const h of houses) if(h.owner==='player'){ const cap=rentCap(h); const before=h.rentBank||0;
  1901→    h.rentBank=Math.min(cap,before+rentPerMin(h)*mins); total+=h.rentBank-before; }
  1902→  return Math.floor(total); }
  1903→// ===== DAILY STREAK: log in N days in a row, rewards escalate. Miss a day and it resets. =====
  1904→const STREAK_REWARDS=[ {cp:150,label:'150 CP'}, {cp:300,label:'300 CP'}, {cp:500,sh:5,label:'500 CP + 5 🔮'},
  1905→  {cp:800,sh:10,label:'800 CP + 10 🔮'}, {cp:1200,dit:5,label:'1.200 CP + 5 💎'}, {cp:2000,dit:10,label:'2.000 CP + 10 💎'},
  1906→  {cp:4000,dit:25,sh:25,label:'4.000 CP + 25 💎 + 25 🔮'} ];
  1907→function todayKey(){ const d=new Date(); return d.getFullYear()*10000+(d.getMonth()+1)*100+d.getDate(); }
  1908→function welcomeBack(){ if(player.spectator)return;
  1909→  const offline=applyOfflineRent();
  1910→  const today=todayKey(), last=player.streakDay||0;
  1911→  let streakReward=null;
  1912→  if(last!==today){
  1913→    const yest=(()=>{const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()-1);return d.getFullYear()*10000+(d.getMonth()+1)*100+d.getDate();})();
  1914→    player.streak=(last===yest)?Math.min(7,(player.streak||0)+1):1;
  1915→    player.streakDay=today; streakReward=STREAK_REWARDS[player.streak-1];
  1916→  }
  1917→  if(!offline && !streakReward) return;                 // nothing to show — don't nag
  1918→  const ov=document.getElementById('wback'), m=document.getElementById('wbackModal');
  1919→  const st=player.streak||1;
  1920→  const dots=STREAK_REWARDS.map((r,i)=>`<div style="flex:1;min-width:36px;text-align:center;padding:6px 2px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid ${i<st?'#ffd24a':'#2a3550'};background:${i<st?'linear-gradient(180deg,#3a2a08,#1a1206)':'#0e1422'}">
  1921→      <div style="font-size:9px;color:${i<st?'#ffd24a':'var(--muted)'}">D${i+1}</div><div style="font-size:14px">${i<st?'🔥':'▫️'}</div></div>`).join('');
  1922→  m.innerHTML=`<h3 style="text-align:center">👋 WELCOME BACK!</h3>
  1923→    ${offline>0?`<div style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a1206,#0e1422);border:1px solid #4a3a12;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin:8px 0;text-align:center">
  1924→      <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)">YOUR PROPERTIES EARNED WHILE YOU WERE AWAY</div>
  1925→      <div style="font-size:30px;font-weight:800;color:#ffd24a;line-height:1.2">+${offline.toLocaleString()} CP</div>
  1926→      <div style="font-size:9px;color:#5be07a">waiting at your houses — tap them or hit 💰 COLLECT</div></div>`:''}
  1927→    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 6px;letter-spacing:.5px">🔥 DAILY STREAK · DAY ${st}/7</div>
  1928→    <div style="display:flex;gap:4px">${dots}</div>
  1929→    ${streakReward?`<div class="sellrow legend" style="margin-top:10px;justify-content:center">🎁 Today's reward: <b style="margin-left:6px;color:#ffd24a">${streakReward.label}</b></div>
  1930→      <button class="btn gold" id="wbClaim" style="width:100%;font-size:13px;padding:13px;margin-top:10px">🎁 CLAIM STREAK</button>`
  1931→      :`<div class="sellrow" style="margin-top:10px;justify-content:center">✅ Already claimed today — come back tomorrow for day ${Math.min(7,st+1)}</div>`}
  1932→    <button class="closebtn" id="wbx">CONTINUE</button>
  1933→    <div class="controls">Log in every day: the streak grows and so does the reward. Miss a day and it resets to day 1.</div>`;
  1934→  ov.classList.add('open');
  1935→  m.querySelector('#wbx').onclick=()=>ov.classList.remove('open');
  1936→  const cbn=m.querySelector('#wbClaim');
  1937→  if(cbn)cbn.onclick=()=>{ const r=streakReward; if(!r)return;
  1938→    const mul=passActive()?2:1;                                   // Empire Pass doubles the streak reward
  1939→    player.gold+=(r.cp||0)*mul; player.shards+=(r.sh||0)*mul; player.dit+=(r.dit||0)*mul;
  1940→    flash=1; burst(player.px,player.py,'#ffd24a',48); sfx(780,0.2,'triangle',0.06);
  1941→    toast('🔥 Streak day '+st+' — '+r.label,'gold'); refreshTop(); ov.classList.remove('open'); };
  1942→}
  1943→function playerTitle(){const L=player.level;
  1944→  if(L>=10&&ownedHouseCount()<2)return 'Squire';            // rank-up needs 2 houses
  1945→  if(L>=50)return 'Legend'; if(L>=40)return 'Tycoon'; if(L>=30)return 'Warlord'; if(L>=20)return 'Baron'; if(L>=10)return 'Settler'; return 'Exile';}
